record.question: Fill in the blanks: (a) Daily Allowance may not be drawn for any day on which a government servant does not reach a point outside a radius of____________ km from a duty point. (b) When both husband and wife are Govt. servant and transferred from one and same station to one and same new station travelling allowance____________ be admissible to both of them as independent Govt. servant. (c) A Govt. servant who is not authorized to travel by air but who performs a journey by air on tour can draw only the ____________ to which he would have been entitled, if he had travelled by rail, road or steamer. (d) The dependency criteria for all purposes should be the minimum____________ alongwith dearness relief thereon. (e) ____________ per cent of Daily Allowance is admissible for absence from headquarters exceeding 6 hours but not exceeding 12 hours.
